textSet.text: There you are! I always feel better when you're around.

playerResponses.text: I'm glad you feel that way, Alistair.

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: I can't help it. It just feels right when we're together. Let's go save the world!

playerResponses.text: Don't get too attached. You know how things can change.

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: I know. But it's hard not to hope for something more, you know?

textSet.text: Back again, are you? I have to say, it never gets old.

playerResponses.text: Always. We make a good team.

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: That's the spirit! Together, nothing can stop us.

playerResponses.text: We'll see how long this lasts.

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: Well, if nothing else, we’ve survived this long. That’s something, right?

textSet.text: You've changed. I can't quite put my finger on it, but something's different.

playerResponses.text: Maybe I'm just seeing the world more clearly now.

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: I hope you're still the same person I trusted. But I suppose people change.

playerResponses.text: Things have been tough, Alistair. Just trying to adapt.

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: I get it. We're all just trying to make it through, I suppose.

textSet.text: I've always trusted you, but lately... I feel like I don't know you anymore.

playerResponses.text: Maybe you never really did.

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: I hope you're wrong about that. I want to believe there's still good in you.

playerResponses.text: I haven't been myself. I just need time.

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: Alright. I'll give you the time you need, but don't let this darkness consume you.

textSet.text: I won't pretend to understand why you've done what you have, but we're allies. That's all.

playerResponses.text: Allies. Nothing more, nothing less.

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: Fine. Let's just focus on our mission then.

playerResponses.text: I'm not asking for your understanding. Just your help.

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: You'll get that, as long as we're in this together.

textSet.text: Ah, here comes my favorite partner in mischief. What new chaos shall we sow today?

playerResponses.text: I'm always ready for some mischief, Morrigan.

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: That's what I like to hear. Let us embrace our freedom to do as we please.

playerResponses.text: Not today. Maybe we could help someone instead?

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: Help someone? You surprise me... and not in a pleasant way.

textSet.text: You and I, we walk a fine line. Do not think I am unaware of your recent... decisions.

playerResponses.text: I do what I must, Morrigan. No more, no less.

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: Then keep your 'musts' to yourself, and I shall do the same.

playerResponses.text: Perhaps one day you'll understand my choices.

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: Perhaps. Or perhaps I will simply lose interest. Only time will tell.

textSet.text: You have fought well, but your motives still puzzle me.

playerResponses.text: I fight to protect those who can't protect themselves.

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: A noble answer, if one I have heard many times before. We shall see if your actions match your words.

playerResponses.text: My motives are my own, Sten. Leave it at that.

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: Very well. We are allies, but do not think we are friends.

textSet.text: You stray from honor, and it makes me question your worth.

playerResponses.text: Honor means little when lives are at stake.

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: You are wrong. Without honor, we are nothing.

playerResponses.text: Perhaps you are right. I will reflect on my actions.

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: Good. A warrior must understand the weight of their choices.

textSet.text: It warms my heart to see someone still fighting for what is right.

playerResponses.text: The world needs people like us, Wynne.

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: Indeed it does. We are the light in the darkness.

playerResponses.text: I'm just doing what needs to be done.

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: And that is often more than most are willing to do. You have my respect.

textSet.text: Your recent actions have troubled me greatly. Are you sure you are on the right path?

playerResponses.text: What is right isn't always clear, Wynne.

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: Perhaps not. But we must strive to find it, nonetheless.

playerResponses.text: I know I've made mistakes, but I am trying.

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: That is all any of us can do. I hope you find your way.

textSet.text: The dog barks happily and wags his tail, looking at you expectantly.

playerResponses.text: Who's a good boy? You are!

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: The dog jumps up, tail wagging furiously, clearly enjoying the attention.

playerResponses.text: Come on, boy. We've got work to do.

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: The dog follows closely, still happy but ready for action.

textSet.text: The dog growls softly, his ears drooping slightly as he watches you.

playerResponses.text: What's wrong, boy? Don't you trust me?

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: The dog tilts his head, then nudges your hand, still wary but seeking reassurance.

playerResponses.text: Stop growling and get in line.

nextDialogue.characterDialogue: The dog reluctantly obeys, tail hanging low.
